selection.rule: sort the eligible pool by (signer proxy ascending, multi-batch after single-batch, sha256('P0-2-R1-2026-10-28|'+clip_id)); take positions 0,2,4,... as pilot and 1,3,5,... as reserve; one draw, no redraw
selection.rule_revision_before_freeze: a first rule (batch-count strata only) gave signer proxy 8 11 pilot vs 5 reserve; replaced once, before any model call and using input-side fields only, by the signer x batch rule
selection.inputs_used: production preprocessing only (duration, budget, frames, batches); no model output, no reference text, no text-derived heuristic tag

openai_image_tokens_per_frame_by_family_.note: 512x288 = 144 patches of 32 px, or 1 tile of 512 px; not verified by an API call

openai_cost_estimate.label: ESTIMATE ONLY: docs prices read 2026-10-29, account pricing and tokenizer unverified, no call made

assumptions.low_basis: Gemini production_45 median output + thinking tokens per call
assumptions.high_basis: 5x the low value (default medium reasoning may think more)

arms.G: production Gemini: asl_utils._call_vlm unchanged (gemini-2.5-flash, temperature 0, response_mime_type application/json, no thinking config = model default), fed the frozen frames
arms.O: OpenAI: the same frozen frames, prompt, labels, batch partition and post-processing; only the model call differs (see openai_request)
arms.G_repeat_optional: second Gemini pass on the same frames, for a run-to-run noise floor (needs approval)

protocol.harness: load production asl_utils (sha-checked) read-only; replace only _extract_frames (returns copies of the frozen JPEGs under production's own file names, asserting the timestamps match) and, for O, _call_vlm_openai; everything else in transcribe_asl (batch loop, segment parsing, empty filter, sort, _merge_adjacent_duplicates, _has_degenerate_repetition) runs unchanged for both arms; per-batch outcomes are recorded by a pass-through wrapper (R03-aware status, production result unchanged)

openai_request.detail: high (FROZEN 2026-10-29, verified by the capability smoke test): a 512x288 frame (144 patches) is within every documented 'high' budget and is sent unresized; production's dormant 'low' would collapse each frame to the base tokens of tile-based models

capability_smoke_2026_10_29.image: locally generated synthetic 512x288 JPEG (white canvas, one rectangle, one ellipse); no photo, no ASL, no pilot/reserve/benchmark content; sha256 469dfe95...
capability_smoke_2026_10_29.request: POST /v1/responses; model gpt-6.1-sol; one user message [input_text instruction, input_text '[t=0.00s]', input_image data URL detail 'high']; text.format json_object; store false; temperature and reasoning omitted; SDK openai==3.41.0, max_retries 0, timeout 60 s
capability_smoke_2026_10_29.image_token_note: 205 input tokens is consistent with ~173 image tokens (144 patches x 1.2) plus ~30 text tokens; the API does not report image tokens separately
capability_smoke_2026_10_29.answer: not stored; only JSON-object validity was checked

openai_request.response_format: text.format = {type: json_object} (Responses equivalent of JSON mode; no schema, as Gemini's application/json mode); the prompt already says 'STRICT JSON'
openai_request.temperature: omitted: neither candidate documents temperature support and both are reasoning-only (no 'none' effort); recorded as a difference from Gemini's temperature 0
openai_request.reasoning_effort: not set (model default; documented as medium for gpt-6.1-sol, not stated for gpt-6-astra), as production sets no Gemini thinking config; the effective value is recorded from the response
openai_request.incomplete: status 'incomplete' is recorded with incomplete_details.reason; any returned text is parsed as usual, no text = parse_failure
openai_request.parser: production _call_vlm parsing for both arms: json.loads, else the first {...} span, else parse failure (the dormant _call_vlm_openai uses json.loads only)
openai_request.refusal: a refusal or null content is a parse_failure, with the refusal flag recorded

unavoidable_api_differences: different provider, model family, tokenizer and image encoder
Gemini Part.from_text / Part.from_bytes vs OpenAI Responses input_text / input_image data-URL parts (same order and content)
JSON mode: Gemini response_mime_type application/json vs OpenAI text.format json_object; neither imposes a schema
image tokens per frame differ (Gemini ~258 observed via usage; OpenAI ~173 documented for 1.2x patch models) at the same pixels
Gemini temperature 0 with default dynamic thinking; OpenAI temperature omitted with default reasoning effort (no non-reasoning mode on either candidate)
neither provider guarantees determinism at temperature 0

batch_outcomes.ok: parsed dict with at least one valid non-empty segment
batch_outcomes.valid_empty: parsed dict with no valid non-empty segment
batch_outcomes.parse_failure: response received, not parseable by the production parser (includes refusal/null content)
batch_outcomes.transport_failure: the call raised (timeout, connection, 5xx, 429 rate limit)
batch_outcomes.run_blocking: auth error, model not found, insufficient quota or spend cap, or HTTP 400/422 request configuration error: halt the whole run

case_status.success: every batch ok or valid_empty, and at least one segment
case_status.partial: at least one failed batch and at least one segment (never counted as success)
case_status.parse_failure: no segment, and at least one batch parse_failure
case_status.transport_failure: no segment, and every failed batch transport_failure

protocol.denominator: all 24 pilot cases in every arm; a case without text is scored as the empty string

retries.primary: none: one attempt per batch, as production transcribe_asl
retries.secondary_view: after the full pass, each transport_failure batch may be retried once after >= 60 s; reported only as a separate 'transport-retried' view; retry calls, tokens and latency count in cost and latency
retries.run_blocking: halt; no scoring of an incomplete arm; resume only with user approval; resumed cases flagged

protocol.call_order: for each pilot case in clip-id order, both arms back to back; which arm goes first = parity of sha256('P0-2-R1-2026-10-28|order|'+clip_id)

harness_choices_frozen_2026_10_29.status: FROZEN before execution (user-approved harness review, 2026-10-29); must not change after any output is seen
harness_choices_frozen_2026_10_29.call_order: even parity of sha256('P0-2-R1-2026-10-28|order|'+clip_id) -> Gemini first, odd -> OpenAI first; 12 cases Gemini-first, 12 OpenAI-first
harness_choices_frozen_2026_10_29.http_400_422: run_blocking configuration error (request format/config): halt the run immediately; never counted as transport_failure; no further calls are spent
harness_choices_frozen_2026_10_29.non_json_object_response: a reply that parses but is not a JSON object is a parse_failure; the case stays in the denominator and the run continues with the next batch/case; the batch records production_would_crash = true when the current production parser would crash on it (transcribe_asl calls data.get on the parsed value)

automatic: success / partial / no_signing_detected / parse_failure / transport_failure counts
metrics.implementation: the P0-A frozen functions (score_repetition.py / production_45_tools.py), sacrebleu defaults
metrics.paired: per-case sentence chrF and WER, O minus G; mean, median, wins/losses/ties (|delta chrF| < 1 = tie); 95 % paired bootstrap CI of mean delta sentence chrF, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261028, case-level (one clip per source video); sensitivity: signer-proxy cluster bootstrap
metrics.regression_gain: regression = O sentence chrF <= G - 10; gain = O >= G + 10

content_review.procedure: blind sheet: reference plus the two outputs as X/Y in seeded random order; arm names hidden until labels are locked
content_review.who: human reviewer; AI pre-annotation, if any, is labelled AI and cannot support verdict A
content_review.automatic_proxy: an output repeated verbatim on 2+ different clips within an arm (descriptive)

metrics.uni_sign: committed Uni-Sign predictions for these clips are reported as a separate reference column, labelled not input-matched; never paired as 'only the model changed'
metrics.not_claimed: no semantic superiority from automatic metrics; Round 1 can name a candidate, not prove semantic correctness (the 2x2 correctness table needs reliable labels)

decision_rule.gate_R_reliability: non-answers (empty + no_signing_detected + parse_failure + transport_failure) O <= G + 1, and partial O <= G + 1
decision_rule.gate_Q_quality: corpus chrF O - G >= +2.0, and paired bootstrap 95 % CI lower bound of mean delta sentence chrF > 0, and corpus WER O <= G; if G_repeat ran, also corpus chrF gain > |G_repeat - G|
decision_rule.gate_S_safety: regressions <= gains, and generic/hallucinated outputs O <= G (blind review; automatic proxy only if review is absent, which makes the verdict provisional)
decision_rule.gate_C_cost_latency: median per-call latency O <= 2x G, and total cost O <= 3x G; cost uses token counts and prices verified at run time; unverifiable prices leave C unresolved
decision_rule.A_replacement_candidate: R, Q, S and C all pass, and blind-review key-content errors O <= G; without human review it is 'A provisional'
decision_rule.B_local_specialist_candidate: not A, R passes, and in at least one pre-specified stratum with >= 5 cases (multi-batch clips; one signer proxy; Gemini non-answer/loop/degenerate cases; Uni-Sign loop_out or empty cases) O has mean delta sentence chrF >= +5 against the stratum's comparator and wins >= 2/3 of its cases
decision_rule.C_pause: anything else, including any R failure whatever the quality numbers
decision_rule.continue_to_round_2: A or B only. A -> confirm on the 23 reserve cases with the same frozen recipe plus blind review; B -> Round 2 input work limited to that stratum. No production change in any case
decision_rule.fixed_before_outputs: thresholds are fixed here and must not change after any output is seen
